guidance.when: Pennsylvania exemptions are allowable and the debtor has an interest in the asset.
guidance.procedure: Add 42 Pa. Cons. Stat. § 8123 as an independent alternative for every kind of property, including real property and business or personal property. Its $300 ceiling limits protection, not eligibility. Separately add § 8124(a) subsections only when the asset actually is wearing apparel, a Bible or school book, a qualifying sewing machine, or a qualifying military uniform or accoutrement.
guidance.avoid_when: Do not withhold § 8123 because the asset exceeds $300 or lacks a listed § 8124 category; do not classify firearms, jewelry, household linens, or vehicles as wearing apparel, and do not cite § 8124(a) without a qualifying subsection.
